name: Natural Product Chemistry
description: Introduction and importance of natural products. Classification and source of natural products. Methods of isolation, biosynthesis and structure elucidation. Designing organic synthesis, Retro-synthetic analysis, disconnection approach, linear and convergent synthesis, Multi-step synthesis of some representative molecules. Importance of natural products: Use of natural products in the fields of pharmacology, biomedicine and industry. Examples and synthesis of pharmacologically active natural products.
